thread:
sara: Heads-up: rolling schema migration 'add_az_index' tonight in the 02:00-03:00 UTC window. Backfill expected ~12m per shard.

matt: Are we pinning service versions for the window? release notes updated?

jules: Yes — pin api v3.2.1 and worker 5.6. deploybot will require manual unpin to continue.

kevin: Added release note link: https://go/release/1234 

deploybot (bot): deploybot: queued migration job mig-20260401-az-index. Holdpoint at canary start. Reply `:proceed` to advance.

sara: @matt @jules can you ack canary policy? Condition: <1% error rate and p50 latency +50ms.

matt: Ack. Also set `quiesce-read` on replicas during backfill to avoid long locks.

jules: SQL snippet to run per-shard: ```ALTER INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_users_az ON users (availability_zone);``` will run with 3s gap between shards.

infra-bot (bot): infra-bot: monitor alert rule `db.locking_spike` enabled for the migration window.

deploybot (bot): deploybot: canary started on shard s1. metrics: errors 0.2%, p50 +30ms.

kevin: Proposing rollback trigger: errors >1% OR p50 >120ms sustained for 5m -> abort and rollback remaining jobs.

sara: Agree. Rollback plan: cancel remaining index jobs, drop any partial index artifacts, reopen traffic. @jules please add exact CLI steps for abort.

jules: Will add. Also note: backfill will touch ~3M rows/shard for cold tenant ranges — if we see sustained IO we'll switch to small-batch reindex plan B.

deploybot (bot): deploybot: canary s1 passed 10m. Promoting to s2/s3. Next holdpoint at 02:20 UTC.

matt: Reminder to update changelog and tag release: `v3.2.1-mig-azindex`.

sara: :thumbsup: I'm on standby on pager.

deploybot (bot): deploybot: migration completed on s3 at 02:37 UTC. Total applied shards: 6, total backfill time 42m, no rollbacks triggered.

kevin: Thanks all. Postmortem item: add pre-apply sampling query to estimate touched rows and expected runtime per shard.

sara: Will capture in the release notes and add to runbook. Closing thread.
